text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival was 
approaching. Nishino Flower seemed to be 
eagerly looking forward to interacting 
with the fans who support her—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"About today's lunch meeting, could we 
move it to before training...?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I want to spend my lunch break 
doing origami.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted to give origami flowers 
to everyone coming to the Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought they would last longer than real 
flowers and make for a lasting memory.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I thought this might be a good chance to 
give back to everyone who always supports 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they'll like it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you very much!
choice_data_list: Will you let me help too?
Will you let me help too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But you're so busy yourself, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is that really what happened...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please! Let's fold some lovely 
flowers together♪

She hasn't realized it yet, but the two of 
us alone might not be able to make enough 
flowers. That would surely leave her 
disappointed.

And so, between training sessions for the 
Fan Appreciation Festival, we decided to 
make as many origami flowers as possible.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The weather is so nice today, maybe I'll 
do my work outside...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flower! You're a lovely flower today 
too, aren't you♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Taiki-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sunbathing, is it, yes? Please, let me 
together with you!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I see, exciting! Then I will help too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! But—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fun things should be enjoyed by everyone! 
That's my motto♪ Please teach me how to 
fold it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to Taiki-senpai, we finished 
making that super huge flower... It was so 
much fun!♪)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Flower-kun, something fell out of your 
pocket. ...An origami flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you so much! Right now, I—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I see. You truly are selfless, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A bug...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...The research I'm working on hit a dead 
end, you see. I was just looking for a 
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold onto the fallen flower as a 
sample. Come by the lab at a later date. 
I'll subtly egg Cafe on, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(It really startled me. When I went to the 
lab, there were all these colorful flowers 
there.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(There were some strangely shaped flowers 
too, it was amazing. To think Tachyon-san 
was helping out. Everyone is so kind—)
(So light and airy...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? That sound just now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Isn't that...!

"And then came the day of the Spring Fan 
Thanksgiving. Having folded a decent 
number of flowers, I met up with her with 
them in hand, but—"
(BA-BAM...!)
choice_data_list:
Wh-What's with this mountain of cardboard 
boxes...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! They're all origami flowers!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki-senpai and Tachyon-san helped me, 
so I was able to make this many♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, someone I don't even know folded 
a whole bunch and lined them up in the 
field for me..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised by how much they look like 
real flowers. I want to properly thank 
them someday...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what's with that big bag...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! So many...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Being surrounded by such kind people 
makes me truly happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Let's go hand them out 
to all the fans right away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much for your constant 
support!

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Such pretty flowers! Thank you, 
Flower-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, please have lots of fun today and 
keep on smiling♪

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I wish I had a grandchild like 
that...

Nishino Flower's origami flowers brought 
great joy to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Flowers from Flower-chan! I'm 
going to frame and display them!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really didn't have to go that 
far...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, thank you very much...♪

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan, this flower has all these 
tiny ripples in it, though..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, those are the flowers that 
Tachyon-san helped out with! Fascinating, 
aren't they♪"

Nishino Flower's handmade flowers were a 
huge hit with the fans. Then... a little 
Umamusume girl walked up to us.

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan C
text_block_list.text: Um...! Please, give me a flower too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan C
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ...U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan C
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to one day become a wonderful, 
mature lady just like Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Me, a big sister...?

text_block_list.name: Flower Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She's kind, looks so cool when she 
runs, and is just a wonderful older 
sister!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...♪

It seemed this day became truly memorable 
not only for the fans, but for Nishino 
Flower as well.
